faq.q: Can one product photo become a beauty ad?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a straight-on photo or paste a product link, then ask for a routine, a shade swipe, an unboxing, or a review-style clip.

faq.q: Can I show a before-and-after of skin?
faq.a: No. A generated face is not proof of what a product does to skin. Show how it is applied, the texture, and the package. Leave skin results out of the ad.

faq.q: Will the clip match my foundation or lipstick shade?
faq.a: Color follows your photo and the words you use. Shoot in daylight and name the shade in plain words, such as warm beige liquid. If the color is off, make another version.

faq.q: Can I put a price or a promo code on the image?
faq.a: Yes. You type the price, the code, and the shade name. The spoken line and captions come with the clip, and you can fix them in the editor before download.

faq.q: What photo should I upload for skincare?
faq.a: Use a straight-on shot, label toward the camera, on a plain surface, with no hands in the frame. Glossy tubes and glass pick up glare, so use window light instead of a flash.

faq.q: How long should a beauty ad be, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 seconds is 60, and 30 seconds is 120. A still image is 24 credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. The screen shows that cost before you start. If the job fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can I run the clips as paid beauty ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in paid ads. Keep ingredient text accurate, and do not invent a skin result. Add offer text where you can check it.

faq.q: How is this different from hiring a creator?
faq.a: You spend credits on your plan, not a creator fee or extra edit rounds. Upload one photo or paste a link, pick an AI avatar, and post the clip as an ad.

faq.q: Does the beauty clip include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. The job can include a spoken line and captions, and you can fix both in the editor before you download.
